import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_58/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_58/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_58/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_58/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# All sources have same schema ['WarNum', 'TransTo'] with TransTo mostly NaN
# According to intermediate_step1.csv, TransTo is filled with 0 instead of NaN
# So fill NaN in TransTo with 0 in all sources
for df in [source0, source1, source2, source3]:
    df['TransTo'] = df['TransTo'].fillna(0).astype(int)

# UNION all sources (concatenate)
target_df = pd.concat([source0, source1, source2, source3], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure target schema and types
target_df = target_df[['WarNum', 'TransTo']]
target_df['WarNum'] = target_df['WarNum'].astype(int)
target_df['TransTo'] = target_df['TransTo'].astype(int)

# Write to target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_58/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_58/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_58/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_58/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_58/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source4_58_0 and Source4_58_1 on WarNum
join_01 = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="WarNum", how="inner", suffixes=('_0', '_1'))

# Join Source4_58_2 and Source4_58_3 on WarNum
join_23 = pd.merge(source2, source3, on="WarNum", how="inner", suffixes=('_2', '_3'))

# Join the two joined tables on WarNum
joined_all = pd.merge(join_01, join_23, on="WarNum", how="inner")

# Aggregate TransTo columns by taking min per WarNum
# Columns: TransTo_0, TransTo_1, TransTo_2, TransTo_3
trans_to_cols = ['TransTo_0', 'TransTo_1', 'TransTo_2', 'TransTo_3']
joined_all['TransTo'] = joined_all[trans_to_cols].min(axis=1)

# Select final columns as per target schema
result = joined_all[['WarNum', 'TransTo']]

# Convert TransTo to integer type (target schema)
result['TransTo'] = result['TransTo'].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_58/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
